title: Scan pushed Git identity ranges
summary: Extend the Git identity validator and pre-push hook so branch pushes scan the exact pushed commit range while the default validator still scans recent local and upstream history.
expectedFailureModes: A branch push scans only the local tip and misses older pushed commits in the range.
A default local validation scans an empty upstream range and silently checks zero commits.
A legitimate platform automation commit is rejected by the stricter project identity policy.
